**Finding: compliant (LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).**

- **No Customer-payable liquidated amount exists.** Fees are entirely usage-based (volume-band rate per US$1m traded, p0056–p0070) plus a fixed $2,500/month support charge (p0086), with no committed volume, shortfall or true-up charge, and no minimum or early-termination fee.
- **Termination consequences are non-monetary.** Article XXI (p0138) requires only return of Licensed Technology and materials; Article IV (p0049) preserves only accrued payments for trades actually performed. Article XXIII (p0142) expressly bars termination damages of any kind against either party, which puts this at the preferred position.
- **Cost-shifting mechanics checked and cleared.** The audit-cost shift on a >5% discrepancy (p0064) and the fee-calculation floor tied to volume actually recorded (p0070) are ordinary commercial mechanics, not stipulated damages.
- **Credits running to us** (rebate shares under p0076) are Vendor-payable and therefore not flagged.

No redline proposed. Worth re-testing if any renewal or amendment introduces a committed-volume or minimum-fee shortfall charge, in which case our fallback would be an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
